description: This file contains helper functions for testing and automating interactive rebase processes in Git. It provides scripted configurations for editors, functions to manipulate rebase sequences, and verification tools for commit modifications during rebase operations.

methods.name: set_fake_editor
methods.description: Configures a fake editor script to simulate user input during an interactive rebase, allowing scripted control over rebase commands and commit message modifications.

methods.name: set_cat_todo_editor
methods.description: Sets a fake editor that outputs the rebase todo list to stdout for verification.

methods.name: test_linear_range
methods.description: Verifies that a range of commits is linear and matches expected subjects.

methods.name: reset_rebase
methods.description: Aborts any ongoing rebase, resets the head, and cleans the working directory to prepare for a new rebase.

methods.name: cherry_pick
methods.description: Cherry-picks a commit, creates a new commit with a specified message, and tags it.

methods.name: revert
methods.description: Reverts a commit, commits the revert, and tags it.

methods.name: make_empty
methods.description: Creates an empty commit with a message and tags it.

methods.name: test_editor_unchanged
methods.description: Checks that environment variables related to the editor have not been modified.

methods.name: set_reword_editor
methods.description: Sets up scripts and environment to test rewording commits during rebase and verifies that reworded commits retain correct authorship.

methods.name: check_reworded_commits
methods.description: Verifies that commits have been correctly reworded by checking commit SHAs and commit messages.

methods.name: set_replace_editor
methods.description: Replaces the rebase todo list with specified contents, used for scripted rebase operations.
